title: A Echo for the Horizon
author: Silas Oyelaran
blurb: Cyrus Villalobos, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
